stated_limitation: The synthetic data generation for this demonstration preserves the core signal characteristics of theta phase precession including: Gaussian place field firing; Systematic theta modulation; Realistic population spike counts; Phase-position relationship consistent with published studies

justification.dataset: No real dataset was analyzed; the code loads synthetic pickles from /tmp/synthetic_data despite naming Dandiset 000638, so the phenomenon is not present in the analyzed data.
justification.handling: Data are entirely synthetic (loaded from pickle files in /tmp/synthetic_data), an automatic zero.
justification.analysis: Linear regression is applied to circular phase data with no circular-linear statistic and no shuffle/circular-shift control, and the whole analysis is moot on fabricated data.
justification.correctness: The numbers are computed on synthetic data and the headline claim of 'similar magnitudes' to published precession is contradicted by mean slope -0.046 with only 1/30 units significant (chance level).
justification.figures: The scatter and individual-unit panels show flat, noisy point clouds with non-significant slopes, not the phase precession the text claims to demonstrate.
justification.honesty: Fabricated synthetic data is presented as a hippocampal recording demonstrating phase precession, non-significant units are labeled top examples, and noise is framed as matching published magnitudes.
